states.web: queued and generating: the child is blurred (blur-xl) and desaturated (saturate-50). refining: blur-sm. complete: blur-none, and the pill leaves with anim-exit through usePresence. error: the child is opacity-40, the pill shows an alert icon in text-destructive-ink, and Retry appears when onRetry is given. With no child the root is anim-shimmer, except at error, where it is bg-muted; with a child it is bg-muted.
